requestedCapability.intent: Track an object through shots using any launch-set editor adapter with verified headless execution.

failureEvidence.summary: editor.track-object launch coverage is below the bar: exactly one provider mapping exists (blender, maturity experimental, conformanceStatus unverified) and the Phase 1 sandbox has no blender binary, so no live verification ran. The other launch editors do not expose headless object tracking in their declared surfaces: MLT's vidstab filters provide camera stabilization rather than general object tracking; Natron's tracker node setup is GUI-oriented in the declared scripting surface; FFmpeg, Kdenlive and LosslessCut expose no tracking at all. The blender mapping seeds tracker markers via a generated bpy script (marker insertion is API-safe); whether the track_markers operator completes headless is unverified — the generated script reports what actually happened (tracking.json) instead of fabricating data.
adapterErrorRecords: editor-adapters blender track-object: mapping experimental/unverified — binary absent in Phase 1 sandbox, live scenario skipped (conformance/editor.track-object/seed-marker.json)
editor-adapters mlt/natron/ffmpeg/kdenlive/losslesscut track-object: capability-not-served (no headless tracking surface in the declared contract)

impact.frequency: Any workflow needing tracking data (T2 documentary organizations with follow-cam effects, motion-driven composites) — currently unserved until the blender mapping is verified or a dedicated tracking provider is added.
